net.slp.useScopes.description: Comma delimited list of strings indicating the only scopes a UA or SA is allowed. (default value is "DEFAULT")

net.slp.DAAddresses.description: Comma delimited list of specific DAs to force UA and SA agents to use. Empty or unset implies dynamic DA discovery.

net.slp.isDA.description: Enables slpd to function as a DA. Default is false.

net.slp.DAHeartBeat.description: Number of seconds for the DA heartbeat. Default is 3 hours (10800 seconds).

net.slp.staleDACheckPeriod.description: Seconds after which a DA is considered stale. Default is 0 (disabled). A minimum of 60s will be applied if non-zero.

net.slp.watchRegistrationPID.description: If true, local registrations are monitored. Default value is true.

net.slp.maxResults.description: Maximum number of results to accumulate and return for a synchronous request. Default value is 256.

net.slp.preferSLPv1.description: If true, libslp sends SLP v1 commands. Default is false.

net.slp.isBroadcastOnly.description: Force broadcasts to be used instead of multicast. Default is false.

net.slp.passiveDADetection.description: Whether passive DA detection should be used. Default is true.

net.slp.activeDADetection.description: Whether active DA detection should be used. Default is true.

net.slp.DAActiveDiscoveryInterval.description: Controls periodic transmission of active DA discovery SrvRqsts. Default setting of 1 disables sending periodic active DA discovery SrvRqsts.

net.slp.multicastTTL.description: Positive integer less than or equal to 255. Default is 255.

net.slp.DADiscoveryMaximumWait.description: Maximum time (in milliseconds) to perform active DA discovery requests. Default is 2000 ms.

net.slp.DADiscoveryTimeouts.description: Value-list of 32 bit integers used as timeouts, in milliseconds, for multicast convergence algorithm during active DA discovery.

net.slp.multicastMaximumWait.description: Maximum time (in milliseconds) to perform multicast requests. Default is 5000 ms.

net.slp.multicastTimeouts.description: Value-list of 32 bit integers used as timeouts, in milliseconds, for multicast convergence algorithm.

net.slp.unicastMaximumWait.description: Maximum time (in milliseconds) to perform unicast requests. Default is 5000 ms.

net.slp.unicastTimeouts.description: Value-list of 32 bit integers used as timeouts, in milliseconds, for unicast datagram transmission to DAs.

net.slp.randomWaitBound.description: Maximum value for all random wait parameters. Default is 5000.

net.slp.MTU.description: Network packet MTU in bytes. Default is 1400.

net.slp.max_ifaces.description: Maximum number of interfaces that can be active if operating as an SA or DA. Default is 100.

net.slp.interfaces.description: List of local addresses to be used. Both IPv4 and IPv6 addresses may be specified.

net.slp.broadcastAddr.description: Broadcast address to use when sending broadcast packets.

net.slp.port.description: Port to use for all SLP messages. Default is 427.

net.slp.useDHCP.description: Whether DHCP should be used for DA discovery and/or scope discovery. Default is true.

net.slp.securityEnabled.description: Whether the agent should enable security for URLs, attribute lists, DAAdverts, and SAAdverts. Default is false.

net.slp.checkSourceAddr.description: Whether the DA or SA will only allow deregistrations and re-registration from the exact host that made the registration. Default is true.

net.slp.indexSrvtype.description: Whether SLP service types should be indexed. Default setting is false.

net.slp.indexedAttributes.description: List of names of attributes with string values that should be indexed.

net.slp.traceDATraffic.description: Printing of messages about traffic with DAs. Default is false.

net.slp.traceReg.description: Dumps of all registered services upon registration and deregistration. Default is false.

net.slp.traceDrop.description: Printing details when a SLP message is dropped. Default is false.

net.slp.traceMsg.description: Printing of details on SLP messages. Very verbose. Default is false.

net.slp.appendLog.description: Whether slpd appends log messages to slpd.log or overwrites the existing log. Default is true.

net.slp.useIPv4.description: Whether IPv4 is enabled for SLP. Default is true.

net.slp.useIPv6.description: Whether IPv6 is enabled for SLP. Default is false.
